mapper.sql: receipt_number, accident_type, location, occurred_at, received_at, claimed_amount, recognized_amount, diagnosis_code, diagnosis_name, treatment_details, hospitalization_period, has_surgery, paid_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM accident_history WHERE history_id = #{historyId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accident_history (receipt_number, history_id, accident_type, location, occurred_at, received_at, claimed_amount, recognized_amount, diagnosis_code, diagnosis_name, treatment_details, hospitalization_period, has_surgery, paid_at) VALUES (#{ah.receiptNumber}, #{historyId}, #{ah.accidentType}, #{ah.location}, #{ah.occurredAt}, #{ah.receivedAt}, #{ah.claimedAmount}, #{ah.recognizedAmount}, #{ah.diagnosisCode}, #{ah.diagnosisName}, #{ah.treatmentDetails}, #{ah.hospitalizationPeriod}, #{ah.hasSurgery}, #{ah.paidAt})
